prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Mastering Your Desktop Companion", "Watch this quick 10-second guide to learn how to drag, interact, mute, or summon your pet anywhere on your screen."]
1: ["Upload High-Clarity Custom Pet Photos", "Ensure lighting is bright and your pet's full face is visible for optimal 3D desktop rendering.", "Optimal Lighting Verified"]
2: ["Verifying Desktop Spawn", "We are making sure your pet safely landed on your desktop bar. Click proceed once you see your friend move.", "Pet Confirmed on Desktop"]
3: []
4: ["Select Your Express Pet Journey", "Pick how you'd like to create your pet today. You can always change settings or add pets later.", "Preset pets launch instantly, while custom pets generate from your photos."]
5: ["Generating Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is currently being rendered and trained. Keep this window open or minimized.", "Estimated completion in under 3 minutes"]
6: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Your pet adoption is officially registered! Your companion is ready to be generated."]
7: ["Sign In to Protect Your Pet Data", "Link your account to save your companion's identity, visual traits, and memory cloud securely.", "Signing in ensures your pet stays saved even if you switch devices or reboot."]
8: ["Pet Generation in Progress", "Feel free to work on other tasks. We will alert you the moment your pet is ready to spawn.", "Notification enabled: Sound alert will play on completion"]
9: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Pet World", "Meet lightweight AI companions that live, react, and assist right on your desktop overlay."]
